purpose: A short label on hover or keyboard focus, with a delay, Escape to dismiss, and the accessibility wiring that makes it readable rather than decorative.

supplied: the trigger is described by the tooltip, so it is announced with the control rather than as stray text
it opens on keyboard focus, not only on hover
Escape dismisses it without moving focus
a delay before opening, so moving the pointer across a toolbar does not flash every label
required: never put essential information only in a tooltip — it is unreachable on touch and gone on blur
an interactive trigger. A tooltip on a non-focusable element cannot be reached by keyboard

composition.notes: Tooltip content must not be interactive: it disappears on blur, so nothing inside it can be reached. Use a Popover when the panel has controls.

safeMutations.rationale: Placement and timing are presentation. The content is the message.
